facts.text: Andrew expressed that the photos of the dogs are so happy that it is contagious and makes him happy.

evidence.quote: Yep, they're so happy it's contagious. It makes me happy just by looking at the photos.

facts.text: Audrey agreed that the dogs are full of energy and bring a smile to her face.

evidence.quote: Haha that's great! They're so full of energy, always bringing a smile to my face!

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that the dogs make everyone smile and expressed excitement about going hiking with them.
